lines.text: The LORD asks if a man can hide in secret places where He cannot see him, since He fills heaven and earth.
The LORD has heard prophets who prophesy lies in His name say, "I had a dream," like their fathers who worshiped Baal.
The LORD says His word is like fire and like a hammer that smashes a rock.
The LORD is against prophets who copy words from old scrolls, and He says He sent them and they benefit the people a little.

wrong_details.true: It was not I who sent them or commanded them

lines.text: The LORD says those who claim "the burden of the LORD" will be forgotten and cast out, and He will punish only them.

wrong_details.true: He will punish that man and his household
